answer: Before an identity can earn or grade, it must publish a week-long work ledger: signed, irregularly timed tasks whose hashes are committed in advance. Peers sample those commitments at random hours and reject any ledger whose timing, custody path, or phrasing clusters with another signer. A violet-team dashboard flags the cluster and slashes the pack. Burst minting is the cause of sybil profit; the effect is that a hollow farm cannot staff a week of uncorrelated live work for every alias, and only a crystal audit trail of kept commitments unlocks rewards.
